card.name: Iron and metal lab values and dosing
card.fires_on: Small connecting tokens such as a dash, space, "by", "than" or "of" right after iron, zinc or other metal terms, mostly in iron lab ranges and iron dosing text. It also fires in text on metal analysis and Wilson's disease.

modes.label: Iron lab ranges
modes.description: The dash, space or digit inside a serum iron reference range such as 60-170 mcg/dL.

modes.label: Iron dosing and thresholds
modes.description: Spaces or linking words in iron infusion or iron therapy instructions.
modes.example: Administer supplemental iron therapy when serum ferritin is less than 100 mcg/L or when serum transferrin saturation is less<< than>> 20%.

modes.label: Metal-related text
modes.description: Linking words or name pieces in text about zinc, metal analysis or Wilson's disease.
